# Chapter 9: Measuring ROI and Building the Business Case

## Why ROI Matters for AI Investments

Every business decision should ultimately deliver value—whether that's increased revenue, reduced costs, saved time, or mitigated risks. AI investments are no exception. Without a clear understanding of the return on your AI investments, you can't make informed decisions about where to invest next, how to prioritize projects, or how to build the case for continued adoption.
